message.content: {"predictors":[{"name":"Net Shareholder Composition Change","construction":"Change in institutional ownership minus change in insider ownership, over past 12 months, divided by shares outstanding. Source: 13F filings, insider filings, CRSP.","rationale":"Divergence between institutions and insiders may capture information asymmetries or sentiment shifts not fully reflected in price.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with large increases in insider ownership and decreases in institutional ownership (low values of the measure)"},{"name":"Accruals Reversal Magnitude","construction":"Absolute value of prior-year total accruals (from balance sheet) divided by average total assets, measured over past 12 months. Source: Compustat.","rationale":"Large prior accruals may set up subsequent reversals, especially if earnings management was present.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with high values of the measure"},{"name":"Long-term Debt Maturity Extension","construction":"Change in ratio of long-term debt maturing in more than 5 years to total long-term debt, over past 2 years. Source: Compustat footnotes.","rationale":"Extending debt maturities may signal financial strength or opportunistic refinancing, affecting future risk and return.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with large increases in the measure"},{"name":"Segment Revenue Diversification","construction":"Herfindahl index of operating segment revenues (Compustat Segment data) subtracted from 1. Higher values mean greater diversification.","rationale":"Revenue diversification may lower risk and support higher expected returns if markets underprice complexity.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with high values of the measure"},{"name":"Inventory Write-down Frequency","construction":"Number of inventory write-down events reported in the past 4 years. Source: Compustat footnotes and accounting changes.","rationale":"Frequent write-downs may indicate conservative accounting or operational renewal, both potentially mispriced by the market.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with high values of the measure"},{"name":"Dividend Change Asymmetry","construction":"Absolute value of dividend increases minus absolute value of dividend decreases, over trailing 5 years, divided by average dividend. Source: CRSP, Compustat.","rationale":"Asymmetric dividend policy may capture management signaling or financial flexibility not captured by yield or payout ratio.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with large positive values (many increases, few decreases)"},{"name":"Patent Citation Velocity","construction":"Number of new patent citations received by firm’s patents in the past 3 years, divided by lagged R&D expense. Source: USPTO, Compustat.","rationale":"Rapidly increasing citations may indicate valuable innovation that is not fully priced by the market.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with high values of the measure"},{"name":"Effective Tax Rate Volatility","construction":"Standard deviation of effective tax rate (tax expense divided by pre-tax income) over past 5 years. Source: Compustat.","rationale":"High volatility may reflect aggressive tax planning or unstable earnings, which may be mispriced.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with high values of the measure"},{"name":"Customer Concentration Trend","construction":"Change in top-5 customer revenue concentration (sum of top-5 customer revenue divided by total revenue) over past 3 years. Source: 10-K segment and customer disclosures.","rationale":"Decreasing dependence on major customers may indicate improving bargaining power or risk diversification.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with large decreases in the measure"},{"name":"Earnings Guidance Surprise Persistence","construction":"Average difference between management’s issued quarterly guidance and actual reported EPS, averaged over past 8 quarters. Source: First Call, I/B/E/S, company press releases.","rationale":"Firms persistently beating conservative guidance may indicate underappreciated profitability or upward momentum.","higher_returns_for":"stocks with high positive values (actual EPS consistently above guidance)"}]}
